workflow_rationale: Multi-service feature requiring new shared models, backend API endpoints, and iOS UI across multiple service layers. Backend must be built before iOS app can consume the new APIs.

phases.name: Shared Models & DTOs
phases.description: Create the SessionCheckpoint shared model and DTOs in ILSShared used by both backend and iOS

subtasks.description: Create SessionCheckpoint shared model in ILSShared/Models/SessionCheckpoint.swift — public struct with id, sessionId, name, createdAt, messageCount, isAutomatic fields
subtasks.notes: Created SessionCheckpoint.swift with public struct (id, sessionId, name, createdAt, messageCount, isAutomatic). Follows Session.swift patterns exactly — Codable, Identifiable, Sendable, Hashable, precondition guards, doc-comments. Build verified: ILSShared target builds clean.

subtasks.description: Add checkpoint-related DTOs to ILSShared/DTOs/Requests.swift: CreateCheckpointRequest, ForkFromMessageRequest, BulkExportRequest, ImportSessionRequest, IntegrityCheckResult
subtasks.notes: Added CreateCheckpointRequest, ForkFromMessageRequest, BulkExportRequest, ImportSessionRequest, and IntegrityCheckResult to Sources/ILSShared/DTOs/Requests.swift. All follow existing Codable/Sendable patterns. Build verified: ILSShared compiles cleanly.

phases.name: Backend Database Schema
phases.description: Create the SessionCheckpointModel Fluent model and migration for persisting session checkpoints

subtasks.description: Create SessionCheckpointModel.swift Fluent model in Sources/ILSBackend/Models/ with id, session_id (FK), name, message_count, is_automatic, created_at fields and toShared() method
subtasks.notes: Created SessionCheckpointModel.swift with @Parent FK to SessionModel, @Field for name/messageCount/isAutomatic, @Timestamp for createdAt. Includes toShared() and from() conversion methods. Build verified successfully.

subtasks.description: Create CreateSessionCheckpoints.swift migration in Sources/ILSBackend/Migrations/ — creates session_checkpoints table with FK to sessions. Revert is no-op per project convention.
subtasks.notes: Created CreateSessionCheckpoints.swift following CreateSessions.swift pattern exactly. Table: session_checkpoints with id (UUID PK), session_id (UUID FK → sessions, cascade delete), name (String required), message_count (Int required), is_automatic (Bool required), created_at (datetime). Revert is no-op per DB-02 convention. Build verified: ILSBackend compiles clean.

subtasks.description: Register CreateSessionCheckpoints migration in Sources/ILSBackend/App/configure.swift under v5.0 block. MUST be appended last. Also add SessionCheckpoint Content extension to VaporContent+Extensions.swift.
subtasks.notes: Registered CreateSessionCheckpoints() in configure.swift v5.0 block (appended last after AddMeshGradientToThemes). Added SessionCheckpoint: Content, CreateCheckpointRequest: Content, BulkExportRequest: Content, ImportSessionRequest: Content to VaporContent+Extensions.swift. Build complete.

phases.name: Backend Checkpoint & Export API
phases.description: Add checkpoint CRUD endpoints, enhanced fork-from-message, session import, bulk export, and integrity check to the backend

subtasks.description: Create SessionBackupController.swift in Sources/ILSBackend/Controllers/ implementing: GET /sessions/:id/checkpoints, POST /sessions/:id/checkpoints (create named checkpoint), DELETE /sessions/checkpoints/:checkpointId, POST /sessions/checkpoints/:checkpointId/restore (forks session up to checkpoint messageCount). Register in routes.swift.
subtasks.notes: Created SessionBackupController.swift with 4 endpoints: GET /sessions/:id/checkpoints (list sorted desc), POST /sessions/:id/checkpoints (create named checkpoint from current messageCount), DELETE /sessions/checkpoints/:checkpointId, POST /sessions/checkpoints/:checkpointId/restore (forks session up to checkpoint.messageCount using .range(..<messageLimit) query). Also added static createAutoCheckpointIfNeeded helper. Registered in routes.swift. Build verified: ILSBackend compiles cleanly (only pre-existing Sendable warnings).

subtasks.description: Enhance the existing fork endpoint in SessionsController to accept optional ?upToMessageId= query parameter. When provided, only copies messages up to and including the specified message ID for point-in-time forking.
subtasks.notes: Enhanced fork endpoint with optional ?upToMessageId= query parameter. When provided, loads all messages sorted by createdAt ascending, finds the cutoff index by message ID, and only copies messages up to and including that index. Returns 400 if the message ID is not found in the session. Build passes successfully.

subtasks.description: Add POST /sessions/import endpoint to SessionsController: accepts a ChatExport JSON body, creates new session named '[Original] (Imported)' and inserts all messages, returns created ChatSession. Add POST /sessions/bulk-export accepting array of session IDs, returning JSON array of ChatExport objects.
subtasks.notes: Added POST /sessions/import (accepts ImportSessionRequest wrapping ChatExport, creates session named '[Original] (Imported)', inserts all messages atomically, returns ChatSession) and POST /sessions/bulk-export (accepts BulkExportRequest with sessionIds, returns APIResponse<[ChatExport]>, limit 50 sessions). Both routes registered in boot(). Build verified: Build of target: 'ILSBackend' complete! (2.06s).

subtasks.description: Add GET /sessions/integrity-check endpoint to SessionsController: queries sessions, verifies messageCount matches actual MessageModel count, returns IntegrityCheckResult list. Accepts ?fix=true to auto-update mismatched counts. Also add createAutoCheckpointIfNeeded helper in SessionBackupController called when message count divisible by interval.
subtasks.notes: Added GET /sessions/integrity-check endpoint to SessionsController with ?fix=true support. Added IntegrityCheckResult: Content conformance to VaporContent+Extensions.swift. createAutoCheckpointIfNeeded was already implemented. Build passes.

phases.name: iOS App Service Layer
phases.description: Add checkpoint API methods to APIClient, create SessionBackupService for auto-checkpoint scheduling, and enhance SessionExportService with PDF export

subtasks.description: Enhance ILSApp/ILSApp/Services/SessionExportService.swift to add exportPDF(session:messages:) -> Data using PDFKit. Creates a PDF document with session header and formatted messages. iOS only (conditional compile for macOS stub).
subtasks.notes: Added exportPDF(session:messages:)->Data using UIGraphicsPDFRenderer with iOS conditional compile. macOS stub returns empty Data. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

subtasks.description: Add checkpoint API methods to ILSApp/ILSApp/Services/APIClient.swift: listCheckpoints(sessionId:), createCheckpoint(sessionId:name:), deleteCheckpoint(id:), restoreCheckpoint(id:), importSession(export:), bulkExport(sessionIds:), runIntegrityCheck(fix:). Use existing actor get/post/delete pattern.
subtasks.notes: Added 7 checkpoint/export API methods to APIClient.swift: listCheckpoints, createCheckpoint, deleteCheckpoint, restoreCheckpoint, importSession, bulkExport, runIntegrityCheck. Followed renameSession pattern with local private body structs and generic return types. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **.

subtasks.description: Create ILSApp/ILSApp/Services/SessionBackupService.swift — actor singleton that tracks message counts per session in UserDefaults, triggers auto-checkpoint API call when count crosses configured interval (UserDefaults 'checkpointInterval', default 10), and exposes runIntegrityCheck(client:) for on-demand use.
subtasks.notes: Created SessionBackupService.swift as actor singleton. Tracks last checkpoint message count per session in UserDefaults (key: "sessionLastCheckpointCount_{UUID}"). Reads interval from UserDefaults "checkpointInterval" (default 10). didSendMessage(sessionId:newCount:client:) triggers createCheckpoint when newCount - lastCount >= interval, then updates stored baseline. resetCheckpointState(for:) clears the baseline. runIntegrityCheck(client:fix:) calls APIClient.runIntegrityCheck and logs issue count. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **.

phases.name: iOS App ViewModels
phases.description: Create SessionCheckpointsViewModel and enhance SessionInfoViewModel with checkpoint and multi-format export support

subtasks.description: Create ILSApp/ILSApp/ViewModels/SessionCheckpointsViewModel.swift — @Observable @MainActor class with: checkpoints: [SessionCheckpoint], isLoading, error, loadCheckpoints(sessionId:), createCheckpoint(sessionId:name:), deleteCheckpoint(_:), restoreCheckpoint(_:) -> ChatSession?
subtasks.notes: Created SessionCheckpointsViewModel.swift with @Observable @MainActor class. Properties: checkpoints: [SessionCheckpoint], isLoading, error. Methods: configure(client:), loadCheckpoints(sessionId:), createCheckpoint(sessionId:name:), deleteCheckpoint(_:), restoreCheckpoint(_:) -> ChatSession?. Uses DeletedResponse for delete return type as EmptyResponse doesn't exist in ILSShared. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

subtasks.description: Enhance ILSApp/ILSApp/ViewModels/SessionInfoViewModel.swift: add ExportFormat enum (json/markdown/pdf), exportJSON(session:) method, exportPDF(session:) method (calls SessionExportService.exportPDF), and runIntegrityCheck() method.
subtasks.notes: Added ExportFormat enum (json/markdown/pdf) with displayName and fileExtension. Added exportJSON(session:) which GETs /sessions/:id/export?format=json as ChatExport and encodes to pretty-printed JSON Data. Added exportPDF(session:) which fetches messages, maps Message→ChatMessage, delegates to SessionExportService.exportPDF. Added runIntegrityCheck() which calls client.runIntegrityCheck() and stores [IntegrityCheckResult]. New properties: exportData: Data?, integrityResults: [IntegrityCheckResult]. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

phases.name: iOS App Views & UI Integration
phases.description: Create SessionCheckpointsView, SessionExportPickerSheet, update SessionInfoView and ChatView with enhanced backup and export features

subtasks.description: Create ILSApp/ILSApp/Views/Sessions/SessionCheckpointsView.swift — List of checkpoints with name, date, messageCount badge. Swipe-to-delete. Tap to restore (fork confirmation alert). Add checkpoint toolbar button with name input. Empty state for no checkpoints.
subtasks.notes: Created SessionCheckpointsView.swift with: checkpoint list (name/date/badge), swipe-to-delete, tap-to-restore with fork confirmation alert, add toolbar button with name-input alert, and empty state. Build verified: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

subtasks.description: Create ILSApp/ILSApp/Views/Sessions/SessionExportPickerSheet.swift — sheet with Picker for format (JSON/Markdown/PDF), Export button that calls ViewModel method and presents ShareSheet with correct file extension. Integrates AirDrop and iOS Share Sheet via UIActivityViewController.
subtasks.notes: Created SessionExportPickerSheet.swift with segmented Picker for JSON/MD/PDF format selection, export button calling SessionInfoViewModel.exportSession/exportJSON/exportPDF, ShareSheet integration for AirDrop and iOS system share. Binary exports (JSON/PDF) write to Caches/ShareExports/ before presenting UIActivityViewController; string exports use ShareSheet(text:fileName:). Private ExportFormat extension adds iconName and exportDescription for the format description row. BUILD SUCCEEDED verified.

subtasks.description: Update ILSApp/ILSApp/Views/Sessions/SessionInfoView.swift: add 'Checkpoints' section with count row and NavigationLink to SessionCheckpointsView. Replace single Export button with SessionExportPickerSheet. Add 'Create Checkpoint' toolbar action.
subtasks.notes: SessionInfoView updated: NavigationStack added, Checkpoints section with count NavigationLink, SessionExportPickerSheet replacing old export, Create Checkpoint toolbar button. Also fixed smart quotes build error in SessionCheckpointsView and added 3 missing files to project.pbxproj. BUILD SUCCEEDED.

subtasks.description: Update ChatView.swift to replace single Markdown export with SessionExportPickerSheet. Update ChatViewModel.swift to call SessionBackupService.shared.didSendMessage(sessionId:newCount:) after each AI response to trigger auto-checkpoint checks.
subtasks.notes: Updated ChatView.swift to replace ShareSheet Markdown export with SessionExportPickerSheet (multi-format picker with JSON/Markdown/PDF). Simplified exportSession() to non-async, removed exportMarkdown/isExporting from ActionState. Updated ChatViewModel.swift to call SessionBackupService.shared.didSendMessage after each AI stream completes. Added SessionBackupService.swift to Xcode project (project.pbxproj) with file reference and build file entries for both iOS and macOS targets. Build succeeded.

subtasks.description: Add 'Session Backup' section to SettingsView.swift: Stepper for checkpoint interval (5/10/20/50 messages, UserDefaults 'checkpointInterval'). Integrity check button calling SessionBackupService showing result alert with count of issues.
subtasks.notes: Added SESSION BACKUP section to SettingsView.swift: Stepper cycling through [5,10,20,50] message options with UserDefaults 'checkpointInterval' persistence, and an integrity check button that calls SessionBackupService.shared.runIntegrityCheck(client:) and shows an alert with the issue count. Build succeeded.

phases.name: End-to-End Integration Verification
phases.description: Verify backend and iOS builds succeed cleanly and core API flows work

subtasks.description: Run full backend build, start server, and verify checkpoint API endpoints with curl. Confirm migration creates the session_checkpoints table. Test create/list/delete/restore checkpoint flow and integrity check endpoint.
subtasks.notes: Backend build succeeds with swift build (without --target flag - using --target only compiles objects, not the linked binary). New backend started from main project directory to use existing sessions DB. Migration CreateSessionCheckpoints applied successfully to main ils.sqlite. All 5 endpoint tests passed: POST checkpoint (create), GET checkpoints (list), POST restore (fork), GET integrity-check, DELETE checkpoint. session_checkpoints table confirmed in DB with correct schema (id UUID, session_id UUID, name TEXT, message_count INTEGER, is_automatic INTEGER, created_at REAL).

subtasks.description: Run iOS build for both ILSApp and ILSMacApp schemes to confirm all new files compile cleanly on both platforms. Fix any platform-specific issues (PDFKit availability, UIKit vs AppKit).

verification.command: xcodebuild -project ILSApp/ILSApp.xcodeproj -scheme ILSApp -destination 'id=50523130-57AA-48B0-ABD0-4D59CE455F14' -quiet 2>&1 | tail -3 && xcodebuild -project ILSApp/ILSApp.xcodeproj -scheme ILSMacApp -destination 'platform=macOS' -quiet 2>&1 | tail -3

subtasks.notes: Both ILSApp (iOS) and ILSMacApp (macOS) builds succeeded with exit code 0. No new errors introduced by any of the new files from this feature. Only pre-existing warnings in APIClient.swift and SyncCoordinator.swift (not from our new code).

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-1-shared-models. iOS services only need shared types, not running backend.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential recommended for Swift build dependency safety

summary.startup_command: swift build --target ILSBackend && PORT=9999 swift run ILSBackend

acceptance_criteria: Backend builds cleanly with swift build
iOS builds cleanly for both ILSApp and ILSMacApp schemes
Checkpoint CRUD API endpoints return correct responses
PDF export generates valid PDF data via PDFKit
Import endpoint correctly recreates session from exported JSON
Integrity check endpoint returns accurate mismatch report
Auto-checkpoint logic triggers at configured message interval
verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk feature adding new DB table and API endpoints. Build verification after every subtask is sufficient.

checks: session_checkpoints table created with correct schema
FK constraint to sessions table enforced
